title: The landing's lint fails on a cited source missing from the header of an article the landing changes
goal: land's lint step fails when an article the item changed cites a source its sources header lacks, so the goal research's S742 fact in settings-and-scopes.md does not land with only a warning among a hundred existing ones

run:
import json, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
src = Path(".").resolve()
tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
shutil.copytree(src / "_tools", tmp / "_tools", ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "*.pyc"))
lint = tmp / ".claude" / "skills" / "kb-verify" / "lint.py"
lint.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
shutil.copy(src / ".claude" / "skills" / "kb-verify" / "lint.py", lint)
root = tmp / "kb" / "public"
(root / "t").mkdir(parents=True)
(root / "_root.md").write_text("---
root: public
id_prefix: S
visibility: public
description: t
---

# public
")
head = "id,url,title,publisher,licence,reuse,retrieved_utc,version_or_date,artifact_sha256,used_in,superseded_by
"
rows = "S100,https://example.com/a,A,X,MIT,copy,2026-01-01,v1,,,
S101,https://example.com/b,B,X,MIT,copy,2026-01-01,v1,,,
"
(root / "_sources.csv").write_text(head + rows)
def art(extra):
    return "---
topic: t/a
priority: P2
applies_to: x
retrieved_utc: 2026-01-01
sources: [S100]
status: partial
files: []
---

# A

## Summary
x

## Facts
- Fact one. [DOC S100]
" + extra + "
## Reference
x

## Examples
x
"
a = root / "t" / "a.md"
a.write_text(art(""))
def run(*argv):
    return subprocess.run(argv, cwd=tmp, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
b = run(sys.executable, "_tools/build_index.py")
def git(*args):
    return run("git", "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@example.com", *args)
git("init", "-q")
git("add", "-A")
git("commit", "-q", "-m", "base")
a.write_text(art("- Fact two. [DOC S101]
"))
p = run(sys.executable, str(lint), "--json", "public/t/a.md")
found = json.loads(p.stdout)
hit = [f for f in found if "cited sources missing from the header" in f["message"]]
assert hit, (b.stderr[-300:], found)
assert hit[0]["level"] == "ERROR", hit
